description: This file contains Redux action creators for authentication-related operations such as sign-in, sign-up, password reset, and forgot password, utilizing API calls and dispatching actions.

methods.name: signin
methods.description: Handles user sign-in by calling API, dispatching AUTH action, and redirecting to dashboard.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Handles user sign-up, creates user profile, dispatches actions, and redirects to dashboard.

methods.name: forgot
methods.description: Triggers forgot password process via API call.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets user password via API and navigates to dashboard.
